main_body: A chest-like box about 16 px wide. It has horizontal orange and light-orange bands, blue corner studs, and a dark lower section with a yellow zigzag pattern.
top_band: Rows 1-3 are a mid-orange band, but it is the same family of tone as the stripes below and reads as a lid face, not a separate lighter top surface. There is no distinct lighter horizontal surface.
evidence: Reading down the middle column, the sprite is a stack of alternating orange and light-orange horizontal stripes (rows 2-9), then a dark panel with a zigzag (rows 10-13). The light bands at rows 4-5 and 8-9 look like vertical planks or straps seen face-on. No lid surface is foreshortened above a distinct front edge line, and there is no eave shadow. The top is at most a 1-2 row rim, so this is a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The piece is a tiny sprite with only about 4 tones on the orange ramp, and the stripes are mostly flat fills with no grain or dots. The outline is a dark neutral line with little material tint. The dark lower panel with yellow zigzag is graphic and flat. Next to the stall and well references it looks thinner and more sticker-like, with far fewer colours per tile.
